ai.seo_question: What does 'high empyrean' mean in the context of Paradise?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase underscores the concept of 'Darajat' (degrees), reflecting the spiritual hierarchy where the righteous ascend based on their piety and proximity to the Ahl al-Bayt. It signifies not merely physical elevation but a metaphysical state of closeness to Divine Presence, often linked to the intercession of the Imams.
